newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka tea prices high in step with world trend.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka tea prices high in step with world trend.

text.p: Prices were buoyant across the board at the Colombo tea auctions, in line with gains in other centres in the world, brokers said.
"Colombo is in step with other auction centres where prices are high due to low supply, following a drought in Kenya," said Lalith Ramanayake of produce brokers John Keells.
Continued strong demand from the CIS and Russia for orthodox tea and traditional seasonal demand from Germany, Japan, the U.S. and the Netherlands were also boosting prices in Colombo, he said.
Produce brokers Forbes & Walker said the anticipated gross sale average was 119 rupees a kg compared to 117.8 rupees last week. ($=58.50 rupees)
The next auction is on August 12-13, when 5.6 million kg will be on offer.
